Bill.BriefDescription: Restricting the sale, foreclosure, or seizure of property belonging to a service member on deployment.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to foreclosures and sales; and adding a new sectionto chapter 61.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 61.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A deed of trust may not be foreclosed during, or within ninetydays after, a service member's period of deployment. (2) A sale, foreclosure, or seizure of property under this chapteris not valid if made during, or within ninety days after, the period ofthe service member's deployment. (3) This section applies only to a service member's obligation onreal property purchased before the period of the service member'sdeployment and for which the service member is still obligated. (4) For purposes of this section, "service member" includes amember of each of the armed forces, including the national guard andarmed forces reserves.
